body: Worker rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-16 20:16Z, from reading src/engram_check_recognition.rs:410). The host recognizes `npx` as a test check ONLY when its FIRST argument is `vitest` (or `jest`). So `npx --prefix ui vitest …` and similar prefixed forms earn NO record. Credited focused Vitest form: run as its own command with cwd = <worktree>\ui, `npx vitest run <file> [-t "<name>"]`. A Codex worker sets the cwd; a Claude worker uses `pushd "<worktree>\ui" && npx vitest run …`. Check any new test command form against the recognizer before handing it to a worker (see also focused-node-form-no-force-exit).
